scope.description: Initial scripted scope for Git add-on style fixes.

language_rules.description: Replace 'amount of characters' with 'number of characters'.
Prefer 'context menu' over 'contextual menu' in Git add-on docs.
Prefer 'Context Menu' over 'Contextual Menu' in titles and captions.
Normalize literal code references to the global ignore file when written as codeph ignore.
Clarify that unstaged resources are not included in the next commit.
language_rules.find:
The <uicontrol>Unstaged files</uicontrol> area lists changed resources
      that are not part of the next commit.
language_rules.replace:
The <uicontrol>Unstaged files</uicontrol> area lists changed resources
      that are not staged for the next commit.

language_rules.description: Normalize repeated AI Positron prose to use the approved keyref-based assistant phrasing.
Normalize the AI Positron view sentence to use the approved keyref-based assistant phrasing.
language_rules.find: The <uicontrol>AI Positron</uicontrol> view opens and <ph keyref="plugin-positron"/> explains
language_rules.replace: The <uicontrol>AI Positron</uicontrol> view opens, and the <ph keyref="plugin-positron"/> assistant explains

language_rules.description: Fix the wording error 'Its lists different actions'.
Use UI markup for the Editor view in the phrase 'current editor'.
Remove the stray space before the colon in 'files :'.
Replace the plain-text Resolve conflict phrase in conflict-action instructions with the approved reusable UI term.
language_rules.find: Resolve conflict, and choose one of the following actions:
language_rules.replace: <uicontrol conref="git-staging-uicontrols.dita#git-staging-uicontrols/git-client-conflicts-resolve-conflict"/>, and choose one of the following actions:

markup_rules.description: Replace bold menu separators with semantic menu markup in simple uicontrol pairs.
Replace escaped menu separators with semantic menu markup in simple uicontrol pairs.
Normalize direct Resolve Conflict UI labels to the approved capitalization before reusable-term replacement.
Replace bold Preferences markup with semantic UI markup.
Remove stray spaces in checkmark table entries.

report_only_rules.description: Report occurrences of Resolve conflict or Resolve Conflict for terminology normalization to reusable UI references.
Report targeted heading-case inconsistencies such as 'Create a new branch'.
Report topics whose index keywords appear incomplete or inconsistent.
Report in-scope files that still contain Oxygen review comments.
Report compare-editor terminology cases that may confuse the prose term, action label, and Diff Files window label.
Report occurrences of 'Positron AI Assistant' for normalization to the approved keyref-based assistant phrasing.
